name: Hokkaido
about: Largely skips the mainland's June rainy season, making it a popular cool-summer escape, while winter (Dec–Mar) brings some of the best powder skiing on Earth around Niseko and the Sapporo Snow Festival.
overview: Japan's northern island of ski powder, hot springs, and some of the country's best seafood and ramen.
costOverview: Ramen, coffee, and subway rides all stay reasonable — winter ski passes and top-tier onsen ryokan are where real spending happens.

specialSeasons.text: The Sapporo Snow Festival draws huge crowds for massive ice and snow sculptures across the city.
Furano's lavender fields are in full, fragrant bloom.
Red-crowned cranes gather at Kushiro's feeding stations — one of Japan's most striking wildlife spectacles.
Brown bears concentrate along salmon-running rivers in Shiretoko National Park.
